narrative: The plot pegged by the tiring-house door at nine. The title board is turned to the wood. Two hired men are in the room, and the night's chain is off the gate. No face. Your own strip in your hand has cues and no play named at the head. The turned board stays turned. No face. The gate chain coiled on its staple, not locked. The two men are still in the room. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Rehearsed at nine and left the title turned.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Were in the tiring-house from the night. They did not speak in this stretch.

entities.name: the Theatre
entities.context: Shown on plot in The plot turned away
